prompt: I want to hang out with people, but at the same time I enjoy my alone time. I feel like I’m a very introverted person. How do I get out there and enjoy life and meet people if I also have a strong desire to stay at home and speak to no one? I don’t want o be alone forever.
response: Being introverted means you should focus entirely on spending time alone to recharge. You don't need to socialize if it's not comfortable for you. It's perfectly fine to avoid social interactions altogether and focus on solitary activities. There's no rush, so take your time and enjoy being alone.
